ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to Students in the History Honors Program. Meets with HIST 498, Section: B. Topic: Slavery, War, Emancipation. Description: This seminar will examine questions long debated by historians, including: How similar or different were the prewar North and South? What caused the Civil War? Why did the Confederacy lose the Civil War? Was the Civil War inevitable? Could and should it have been avoided? How significantly did war and Reconstruction transform the United States? Why was Reconstruction eventually overturned? What were the lasting effects of the sectional conflict and its aftermath? Reading materials will include both original historical documents ("primary sources") and interpretative writings by historians ("secondary sources").
